title: CAMERA: DV 16mm tape camcorder, handheld POV/self-shot by CHASE. Occasional…
content:
CAMERA: DV 16mm tape camcorder, handheld POV/self-shot by CHASE. Occasional propped shots on bench/floor. Shaky framing, soft focus, clumsy zooms, face cutoffs, chaotic movement during exercise, steadier during recovery. Camcorder never visible.

LOOK: Soft blurry tape quality, faint noise, bloomed gym lights, flickering exposure, muted contrast, realistic skin tones. Sweat progressively builds.

STYLE: High-energy, breathless HIIT vlog. Intense exercise bursts → short recovery beats. Genuine exhaustion and determination.

CHASE: Korean idol in her 20s, long black high ponytail becoming damp, expressive eyes, flushed cheeks, slim athletic build. Modest long-sleeve athletic top, joggers/leggings, sneakers, towel, no jewelry.

SETTING: Evening gym open floor, mats, mirrors, small speaker/phone, water bottle, soft overhead lighting.

30s / 9 CUTS:

1. 3s Propped: Ready on mat, bouncing. “Okay, HIIT round thirty seconds on, let’s go!”
2. 3s Handheld: Fast jumping jacks. “Okayalready feeling this”
3. 2.5s  Propped: Hands on knees, recovering. “Okay five seconds that’s it”
4. 3s  Low/propped: Intense mountain climbers, sweat visible. Heavy breathing only.
5. 2.5s Propped: Sitting back, wiping sweat. “Okay, that one’s brutal”
6. 3.5s Handheld: Burpees, increasing motion blur. “Why did Ipick burpees”
7. 2.5s Macro: Hands gripping mat, sweat dripping, chest heaving. No dialogue.
8. 3s Propped: Collapses onto back, laughing breathlessly. “Okay I think I’m dying”
9. 3.5s Selfie: Slowly sits up, drinks water, tired grin. “Okay, that’s a wrap worth it though. See you guys!”

es.content:
---
CÁMARA: videocámara DV de cinta de 16 mm, POV/self-shot en mano por CHASE. Tomas ocasionales apoyadas sobre un banco o el suelo. Encuadre tembloroso, enfoque suave, zooms torpes, cortes de rostro, movimiento caótico durante el ejercicio, más estable durante la recuperación. La videocámara nunca es visible.

LOOK: calidad suave y borrosa de cinta, ruido tenue, luces del gimnasio con bloom, exposición parpadeante, contraste apagado, tonos de piel realistas. El sudor se acumula progresivamente.

STYLE: vlog de HIIT de alta energía y sin aliento. Ráfagas intensas de ejercicio → breves momentos de recuperación. Agotamiento y determinación genuinos.

CHASE: ídolo coreana de veintitantos, coleta alta larga y negra que se va humedeciendo, ojos expresivos, mejillas sonrojadas, complexión atlética y esbelta. Top deportivo modesto de manga larga, joggers/leggings, zapatillas, toalla, sin joyas.

SETTING: gimnasio al atardecer, zona abierta, colchonetas, espejos, pequeño altavoz/teléfono, botella de agua, iluminación suave desde arriba.

30s / 9 CORTES:

1. 3s Apoyada: lista sobre la colchoneta, rebotando. “Okay, HIIT round thirty seconds on, let’s go!”
2. 3s En mano: jumping jacks rápidos. “Okayalready feeling this”
3. 2.5s Apoyada: manos en las rodillas, recuperándose. “Okay five seconds that’s it”
4. 3s Baja/apoyada: mountain climbers intensos, sudor visible. Solo respiración pesada.
5. 2.5s Apoyada: sentada hacia atrás, secándose el sudor. “Okay, that one’s brutal”
6. 3.5s En mano: burpees, aumentando el motion blur. “Why did Ipick burpees”
7. 2.5s Macro: manos agarrando la colchoneta, sudor goteando, pecho agitado. Sin diálogo.
8. 3s Apoyada: se desploma boca arriba, riendo sin aliento. “Okay I think I’m dying”
9. 3.5s Selfie: se incorpora lentamente, bebe agua, sonrisa cansada. “Okay, that’s a wrap worth it though. See you guys!”
---

fr.content:
CAMÉRA : Caméscope DV 16 mm, prise de vue à la main en POV/self-shot par CHASE. Quelques plans posés sur un banc/au sol. Cadre tremblant, mise au point douce, zooms maladroits, visages coupés, mouvements chaotiques pendant l’exercice, plus stables pendant la récupération. Le caméscope n’est jamais visible.

LOOK : Qualité de bande douce et floue, léger bruit, lumières de salle de sport surexposées, exposition qui scintille, contraste atténué, tons de peau réalistes. La sueur s’accumule progressivement.

STYLE : Vlog HIIT à haute énergie, essoufflé. Sauts d’effort intenses → courts temps de récupération. Fatigue et détermination authentiques.

CHASE : Idole coréenne dans la vingtaine, longue queue de cheval noire devenant humide, regard expressif, joues rougies, silhouette athlétique fine. Haut de sport manches longues modeste, jogging/legging, baskets, serviette, aucun bijou.

SETTING : Espace ouvert d’une salle de sport en soirée, tapis, miroirs, petite enceinte/téléphone, bouteille d’eau, éclairage doux au plafond.

30 s / 9 PLANS :

1. 3 s Posé : Prête sur le tapis, elle rebondit. « Okay, HIIT round thirty seconds on, let’s go! »
2. 3 s À la main : Jumping jacks rapides. « Okayalready feeling this »
3. 2,5 s Posé : Mains sur les genoux, en récupération. « Okay five seconds that’s it »
4. 3 s Bas/posé : Mountain climbers intenses, sueur visible. Respiration lourde seulement.
5. 2,5 s Posé : Assise en arrière, s’essuyant la sueur. « Okay, that one’s brutal »
6. 3,5 s À la main : Burpees, flou de mouvement qui augmente. « Why did Ipick burpees »
7. 2,5 s Macro : Mains agrippant le tapis, sueur qui goutte, poitrine haletante. Pas de dialogue.
8. 3 s Posé : S’effondre sur le dos, riant sans souffle. « Okay I think I’m dying »
9. 3,5 s Selfie : Se redresse lentement, boit de l’eau, sourire fatigué. « Okay, that’s a wrap worth it though. See you guys! »

ja.content:
---
CAMERA: DV 16mmテープのビデオカメラ、CHASEによる手持ちPOV／自撮り。時々、ベンチや床に置いた固定ショット。ブレたフレーミング、ソフトフォーカス、不器用なズーム、顔の切れ、運動中のカオスな動き、回復中はやや安定。ビデオカメラ自体は映らない。

LOOK: 柔らかくぼやけたテープ質感、かすかなノイズ、にじんだジムのライト、ちらつく露出、抑えめのコントラスト、自然な肌色。汗は徐々に増えていく。

STYLE: ハイエナジーで息の詰まるようなHIIT vlog。激しい運動のバースト → 短い回復の間。リアルな疲労感と決意。

CHASE: 20代の韓国人アイドル。長い黒髪のハイポニーテールは徐々に湿り、表情豊かな目、赤らんだ頬、細身でアスレチックな体型。控えめな長袖のアスレチックトップ、ジョガー／レギンス、スニーカー、タオル、アクセサリーなし。

SETTING: 夕方のジムのオープンスペース、マット、鏡、小さなスピーカー／スマホ、水筒、やわらかな天井照明。

30s / 9 CUTS:

1. 3s Propped: マットの上で準備しながらバウンスする。「Okay, HIIT round thirty seconds on, let’s go!」
2. 3s Handheld: 素早いジャンピングジャック。「Okayalready feeling this」
3. 2.5s  Propped: 膝に手をついて回復。「Okay five seconds that’s it」
4. 3s  Low/propped: 激しいマウンテンクライマー、汗が見える。荒い呼吸のみ。
5. 2.5s Propped: 座り込んで、汗を拭う。「Okay, that one’s brutal」
6. 3.5s Handheld: バーピー、モーションブラーが増していく。「Why did Ipick burpees」
7. 2.5s Macro: マットを握る手、汗が滴り、胸が大きく上下する。セリフなし。
8. 3s Propped: 仰向けに倒れ込み、息を切らしながら笑う。「Okay I think I’m dying」
9. 3.5s Selfie: ゆっくり起き上がり、水を飲み、疲れた笑みを浮かべる。「Okay, that’s a wrap worth it though. See you guys!」
---

ko.content:
CAMERA: DV 16mm 테이프 캠코더, CHASE가 직접 찍는 핸드헬드 POV/셀프샷. 가끔 벤치나 바닥에 받쳐 둔 샷. 흔들리는 구도, 부드러운 초점, 어설픈 줌, 얼굴이 잘리는 프레이밍, 운동 중에는 혼란스러운 움직임, 회복할 때는 더 안정적. 캠코더는 절대 보이지 않음.

LOOK: 부드럽고 흐릿한 테이프 화질, 희미한 노이즈, 번지는 체육관 조명, 깜빡이는 노출, 절제된 대비, 자연스러운 피부 톤. 땀이 점점 쌓임.

STYLE: 에너지가 넘치고 숨 가쁜 HIIT 브이로그. 강렬한 운동 구간 → 짧은 회복 구간. 진짜 같은 지침과 결의.

CHASE: 20대 한국 아이돌, 젖어 가는 긴 검은색 하이 포니테일, 표정이 풍부한 눈, 상기된 볼, 슬림한 운동 체형. 단정한 긴팔 운동 상의, 조거 팬츠/레깅스, 스니커즈, 수건, 액세서리 없음.

SETTING: 저녁 시간의 체육관 오픈 플로어, 매트, 거울, 작은 스피커/휴대폰, 물병, 부드러운 천장 조명.

30초 / 9컷:

1. 3초 받쳐 둔 샷: 매트 위에서 준비하며 몸을 가볍게 튕김. “Okay, HIIT round thirty seconds on, let’s go!”
2. 3초 핸드헬드: 빠른 점핑잭. “Okayalready feeling this”
3. 2.5초 받쳐 둔 샷: 무릎에 손을 짚고 회복. “Okay five seconds that’s it”
4. 3초 로우/받침: 강도 높은 마운틴 클라이머, 땀이 보임. 거친 숨소리만.
5. 2.5초 받쳐 둔 샷: 뒤로 앉아 땀을 닦음. “Okay, that one’s brutal”
6. 3.5초 핸드헬드: 버피, 움직임 블러가 점점 심해짐. “Why did Ipick burpees”
7. 2.5초 매크로: 매트를 움켜쥔 손, 땀이 떨어지고 가슴이 크게 오르내림. 대사 없음.
8. 3초 받쳐 둔 샷: 등을 대고 쓰러지듯 눕고, 숨을 헐떡이며 웃음. “Okay I think I’m dying”
9. 3.5초 셀피: 천천히 일어나 물을 마시고, 지친 미소. “Okay, that’s a wrap worth it though. See you guys!”

pt.content:
CAMERA: Filmadora DV de fita 16mm, POV/self-shot na mão por CHASE. Algumas tomadas apoiadas em um banco/chão. Enquadramento trêmulo, foco suave, zooms desajeitados, cortes no rosto, movimento caótico durante o exercício, mais estável na recuperação. A filmadora nunca aparece.

LOOK: Qualidade suave e borrada de fita, ruído sutil, luzes da academia estouradas, exposição piscando, contraste suave, tons de pele realistas. O suor vai se acumulando progressivamente.

STYLE: Vlog de HIIT de alta energia, ofegante. Explosões intensas de exercício → breves momentos de recuperação. Exaustão e determinação genuínas.

CHASE: Idol coreana na casa dos 20 anos, rabo de cavalo alto longo e preto ficando úmido, olhos expressivos, bochechas coradas, corpo atlético e esguio. Top esportivo modesto de manga longa, joggers/leggings, tênis, toalha, sem joias.

SETTING: Área aberta da academia à noite, colchonetes, espelhos, pequeno alto-falante/celular, garrafa de água, iluminação suave no teto.

30s / 9 CORTES:

1. 3s Apoiada: Pronta no colchonete, quicando. “Okay, HIIT round thirty seconds on, let’s go!”
2. 3s Na mão: Polichinelos rápidos. “Okayalready feeling this”
3. 2.5s Apoiada: Mãos nos joelhos, se recuperando. “Okay five seconds that’s it”
4. 3s Baixa/apoiada: Mountain climbers intensos, suor visível. Apenas respiração pesada.
5. 2.5s Apoiada: Sentando para trás, enxugando o suor. “Okay, that one’s brutal”
6. 3.5s Na mão: Burpees, motion blur aumentando. “Why did Ipick burpees”
7. 2.5s Macro: Mãos agarrando o colchonete, suor pingando, peito arfando. Sem diálogo.
8. 3s Apoiada: Cai de costas, rindo sem fôlego. “Okay I think I’m dying”
9. 3.5s Selfie: Senta-se lentamente, bebe água, sorriso cansado. “Okay, that’s a wrap worth it though. See you guys!”

zh.content:
CAMERA：DV 16mm 磁带摄像机，由 CHASE 手持 POV/自拍拍摄。偶尔会把机器架在长凳/地板上。画面构图摇晃、对焦偏软、变焦笨拙、脸部经常被切掉，运动时动作混乱，恢复时则更稳。摄像机始终不入镜。

LOOK：柔和、模糊的磁带质感，轻微噪点，健身房灯光泛光，曝光闪烁，对比度偏低，真实肤色。汗水逐渐累积。

STYLE：高能、气喘吁吁的 HIIT vlog。高强度运动爆发 → 短暂恢复节奏。真实的疲惫与决心。

CHASE：20 多岁的韩国偶像，长黑色高马尾逐渐被汗水打湿，眼神灵动，脸颊泛红，身材纤细健美。穿着朴素的长袖运动上衣、慢跑裤/紧身裤、运动鞋，带毛巾，不戴首饰。

SETTING：傍晚健身房的空旷区域，垫子、镜子、小音箱/手机、水瓶，柔和的顶灯。

30秒 / 9个镜头：

1. 3秒 架机：站在垫子上准备，原地轻跳。 “Okay, HIIT round thirty seconds on, let’s go!”
2. 3秒 手持：快速开合跳。 “Okayalready feeling this”
3. 2.5秒 架机：双手撑膝，恢复。 “Okay five seconds that’s it”
4. 3秒 低机位/架机：高强度登山跑，汗水可见。 只有沉重的呼吸声。
5. 2.5秒 架机：坐回去，擦汗。 “Okay, that one’s brutal”
6. 3.5秒 手持：波比跳，运动模糊加重。 “Why did Ipick burpees”
7. 2.5秒 微距：双手抓着垫子，汗水滴落，胸口剧烈起伏。 无对白。
8. 3秒 架机：仰倒在地，喘着气笑。 “Okay I think I’m dying”
9. 3.5秒 自拍：慢慢坐起来，喝水，疲惫地咧嘴一笑。 “Okay, that’s a wrap worth it though. See you guys!”
